title: Trust Bank SG
meta_description: The digital bank for the everyday us.
full_description: Trust makes banking transparent, easy and rewarding.We are Trust, Singapore's digital bank backed by a unique partnership between Standard Chartered, one of the world's most trusted banks with more than 160 years experience in Singapore, and FairPrice Group, the nation’s leading grocery retailer for almost 50 years. With a combined heritage in driving prosperity and making life better, we want to add to the everyday life by building Trust with every person in Singapore.GET STARTED Open an account and get your digital card issued within minutes.  Apply easily for a Trust card using Myinfo to pre-fill your application.GET A CREDIT CARD WITH UP TO 21% SAVINGS  With a minimum monthly spend, NTUC Union Members can enjoy up to 21% savings with the FairPrice Group. For everyone else, get up to 15% savings on your everyday needs.ALSO SIGN UP FOR A SAVINGS ACCOUNT WITH UP TO 2.5% P.A. INTEREST  Earn up to 2.5% p.a. interest on the first S$75,000 deposit. Plus, enjoy additional savings of up to 11% on groceries and food at FairPrice Group with our debit card. Terms and conditions apply. Insured up to S$75k by SDIC.INSTANT S$25 E-VOUCHER REWARDReceive a S$25 FairPrice E-Voucher in-app when you first make a Visa transaction with your Trust card.COMPLIMENTARY FIRST 2 MONTHS FAMILY PERSONAL ACCIDENT COVERAGEGet covered for the first two months with Family Personal Accident Insurance, a product underwritten and issued by Income. Coverage is up to S$8,000 for death and permanent total disability due to accidents. Your policy will continue at just S$0.50 a month thereafter.Note that this offer is limited to first 100,000 successful Trust credit card sign-ups or 31 December 2022, whichever is earlier. Protected up to specified limits by SDIC.LIVE FEE-LESSLYEnjoy the freedom of a credit card account with no annual fee, no foreign transaction fee and no cash advance fee. And a savings account with no lock-in period, no minimum balance requirement and no monthly fees.A BETTER DIGITAL CARD EXPERIENCEWith just one tap, you can instantly switch between debit and credit to suit your spending needs. And with a numberless physical card (without the expiry date or CVV printed on the card), this reduces the risk of compromising your card.GET REWARDS EVERY DAY Earn Linkpoints on eligible card spend and unlock coupons and stamp cards at your favourite merchants. Our Trust App has a smart tracker too! You’ll know exactly where you are against your reward targets in real-time so you need never miss out on bonus rewards again.SAFETY IS OUR TOP PRIORITYGet instant transaction notifications. We also monitor transactions and online payments 24/7 to keep your account secure. Trust also offers strong encryption and biometric login – all to protect your account and personal information.CUSTOMER SERVICE THAT PUTS YOU FIRSTWe are available 24/7. Whenever you need help, reach out to us via the in-app chat or call.You can also call us on 313-TRUST (313-87878).Terms and conditions apply. For more information, visit trustbank.sg
